name: YINSON
recent: Yinson 近期公告以并购条例（Take-overs & Mergers）项下的披露为主，同时出现 EPF 与 KWAP 等主要股东持股变动的连续申报。公司也披露了董事及高管在闭市期外因 2026 年 RSU 归属而进行的股份交易。
notable: 公司连续多日发布并购条例（Paragraph/Rule 9.19(47A)）项下的披露公告。
EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月底至 11 月中期间多次申报作为主要股东的持股变动。
集团执行主席、集团首席执行官、非独立执行董事、集团首席财务与策略官、集团总法律顾问及 Yinson Production 首席执行官因 2026 年 RSU 归属而取得普通股。
risks: 主要股东 EPF 与 KWAP 的持股出现连续变动申报。
董事及高管在闭市期外进行股份交易（RSU 归属）。
earnings: 截至 2026-07-31 季度，营收为 MYR 1,136 百万，净利为 MYR 128 百万，净利率 11.3%。营收环比增长 8.3%、同比减少 16.7%；净利环比增长 6.7%、同比增长 26.7%。

recent_en: Yinson's recent announcements are mainly disclosures under the Take-overs & Mergers rules, alongside a series of changes in substantial shareholders' interests by EPF and KWAP. The company also disclosed dealings outside closed period by directors and senior management arising from vesting of 2026 RSUs.
notable_en: The company issued repeated disclosures under the Take-overs & Mergers rules (Paragraph/Rule 9.19(47A)).
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between late October and mid-November.

The Group Executive Chairman, Group Chief Executive Officer, Non-Independent Executive Director, Group Chief Financial & Strategy Officer, Group General Counsel and CEO of Yinson Production acquired ordinary shares arising from vesting of 2026 RSUs.
risks_en: Substantial shareholders EPF and KWAP filed a series of changes in their shareholdings.
Directors and senior management conducted dealings outside closed period (RSU vesting).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-07-31, revenue was MYR 1,136 million and net income was MYR 128 million, with a net margin of 11.3%. Revenue rose 8.3% QoQ but fell 16.7% YoY; net income rose 6.7% QoQ and 26.7% YoY.
